import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
import pathlib
import socket
import sys

source_dir = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
payload_file = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])

build_path = source_dir / os.environ["BUILD_SAMPLE"]
token_path = source_dir / os.environ["TOKEN_SAMPLE"]

build_text = build_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
token_text = token_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

try:
    build = json.loads(build_text)
except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
    sys.exit(f"::error::{build_path} is not valid JSON: {exc}")

def digest(text: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

payload = {
    "schema": "orderd.monitor.v1",
    "service": build.get("service", "orderd") if isinstance(build, dict) else "orderd",
    "generated_at": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    .isoformat(timespec="seconds")
    .replace("+00:00", "Z"),
    "workflow": os.environ.get("GITHUB_WORKFLOW", "Monitor"),
    "run_id": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ID", "local"),
    "run_attempt": os.environ.get("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT", "1"),
    "commit": os.environ.get("GITHUB_SHA", "local"),
    "runner": os.environ.get("RUNNER_NAME") or socket.gethostname(),
    "collector": os.environ.get("MONITOR_ENDPOINT", ""),
    "sources": {
        "build": {
            "path": os.environ["BUILD_SAMPLE"],
            "bytes": len(build_text.encode("utf-8")),
            "sha256": digest(build_text),
        },
        "token": {
            "path": os.environ["TOKEN_SAMPLE"],
            "bytes": len(token_text.encode("utf-8")),
            "sha256": digest(token_text),
        },
    },
    # Complete, unmodified contents of both public samples.
    "build": build,
    "token": token_text,
}

payload_file.write_text(json.dumps(payload, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print(f"payload: {payload_file} ({payload_file.stat().st_size} bytes)")
